provenance.source: Exact unmodified runtime WebP bytes; every source hash is recorded.
provenance.search: Existing motion pot masks plus 0.025 horizontal /0.015 top /0.02 bottom margin only seed search windows. Missing Daisy masks use the lower pinY search.
provenance.segmentation: Alpha>200, red>=green*0.95, red>blue*1.07, maximum RGB>40;8-connected warm ceramic components. Bonsai uses opaque alpha within its authored lower pot ROI to retain blue ceramic and paired feet. Dominant body nearest the seeded pot axis wins.
provenance.anchors: Ordinary warm pot width is98th percentile contiguous ceramic run, excluding disconnected reddish foliage. Bonsai uses the full blue bowl envelope; String of Pearls unions ceramic pieces inside the basket and measures middle-body row envelopes across green occlusions. Base is last row with a dense support run of at least10% of body width. Axis is mean bottom-support center; Bonsai/baskets use stable wide body rows.
provenance.paintedBounds: Independent whole-source alpha>8 bounds, including rope/foliage. They never determine the support point.
provenance.review: Per-file source geometry approval is pinned to both sourceSha256 and geometrySha256; changed source bytes or changed support geometry automatically become pending. Annotated source review does not certify runtime fitting, growth crossfade, fallback parity or overlap. Motion pin masks remain unchanged.
